description: Google's Lyria 3.5 writes and sings a full-length song from a text description, with lyrics and section tags if you want them. One flat price. Compared with other audio tools: premium. Price: $0.109 per song, charged only on success. One call = one full song with vocals.

prompt.description: Genre, mood, instruments and voice; you can include lyrics with [Verse] and [Chorus] tags
